releases.name: duo-editor
releases.description: The Duo editor on iPhone Duo: the claim on the left page and question cards on the right, built on Xcode Cloud and shipped to TestFlight testers.

clusters.title: iPhone Duo editor: one claim, one refutation, on TestFlight
clusters.description: The native slices of CIT-439: the iOS project, the build-time JSON bundle, the Xcode Cloud workflows, the supervisor reading their results, and the SwiftUI app. The Linux-capable pieces run through the agent first; the one-time Xcode Cloud setup needs the maintainer on a Mac. Review findings on the iOS project (CIT-521, CIT-522) are fixed as follow-ups.
